reviewNotes: Alex's complete six-line schedule dialogue asset is translated directly from English. The Night Market, clinic and gridball scenes retain their context, with the speaker marker and every dialogue control exact.

winter_17.000.source: Have you seen the mermaid show? It's my favorite...
winter_17.000.translation: Ai văzut spectacolul sirenei? Este preferatul meu...

marriage_Mon.000.source: I'm going to hang out here all day. My grandparents aren't getting any younger...
marriage_Mon.000.translation: Voi petrece toată ziua aici. Bunicii mei nu întineresc...

summer_16.000.source: Hi. Eh, I just twisted my ankle. Seeing if I can get it taped.
summer_16.000.translation: Salut. Ăă, tocmai mi-am scrântit glezna. Văd dacă mi-o bandajează.

summer_16.001.source: Yeah, yeah... I'm good, doc. Just tape it up, okay?
summer_16.001.translation: Da, da... sunt bine, doctore. Doar bandajeaz-o, bine?

Sun.000.source: %Alex is completely engrossed in the game. He doesn't notice your presence.
Sun.000.translation: %Alex este complet absorbit de meci. Nu-ți observă prezența.

Sun.000_married.source: Hey, @! You can watch the game with us if you want, but no pressure if you're busy.
Sun.000_married.translation: Hei, @! Poți să urmărești meciul cu noi dacă vrei, dar nu-i nicio problemă dacă ai treabă.
